incidents_history.title: Transient 504 Gateway Timeout during automated daily backup
incidents_history.description: Elevated latency during EFS daily snapshot synchronization.
incidents_history.root_cause: Concurrent I/O burst on EFS General Purpose bursting mode.
incidents_history.action_taken: Switched EFS provisioned throughput to 50 MB/s.

incidents_history.title: LiteLLM AI Sidecar Memory Pressure
incidents_history.description: Occasional high token request caused Python process restart.
incidents_history.root_cause: Unbounded context window in document summary worker.
incidents_history.action_taken: Configured max_tokens limit in litellm config.

incident.root_cause: Storix desktop clients holding idle connections above max_connections parameter.
incident.action_taken: Automated script draining idle connections; tuning idle_in_transaction_session_timeout.
